One ink line beginning in the left ruled margin. The reading 'ff. 2-115, S. 18 (last two figures not filled in), + f. 4 from another MS. of same work.' agrees with the image. The small cursive remains approximate, as the candidate notes. The gutter arrow at about y 3620 crosses from fol. 321 √c.190 to this line. The facing page also shows an arrow at c.190, so the link is secure.

Ink title with extent. 'mātā' and 'mālā' remain possible readings, as the candidate says. A small dot or circle sits above the 'kṣ/ā' of 'pañcākṣarī', just above the pencil query. It is probably a pencil reference mark tied to b004. It is recorded under r004.
Pencil bracketed query '[? = °pañcadaśākṣarī]' beneath the title. The mark above the title is not described in the candidate; an annotation is added.
Ink note to the right on the b003 line. The first word looks like 'lat'/'Cat.' and is not secure. The candidate's literal_text presents 'Cat.' as certain, so it is changed to mark the uncertainty.

Incipit line. It has the interlinear 'bhuktyā' above a struck word and a caret 'm' above 'karaṇa'. The word before the cancellation looks like 'āsane' rather than 'āsana'. The candidate already flags this ending as uncertain. Attachment is doubtful: facing-page √b.99(3) lies at almost exactly the same height (about y 4426), and no arrow connects either entry. The certainty is lowered.
